name: {/PLACEHOLDER/} A Transgender Story
source: You play as Sky, a thirty year old data analyst working for a massively powerful mega-corporation with unclear motives. Bored with the monotony of their job, Sky often seeks distractions to pass the day more quickly. Once work is over for the day, Sky returns to their rundown apartment to spend time in an elaborate virtual world inside of a highly advanced Virtual Reality system. As you progress through the stages of each day you will encounter various characters and events that help Sky as they explore their gender and sexuality. You will also be trying to unravel the mystery of a mysterious VR plugin system called {/PLACEHOLDER/} and the secretive services they offer to exclusive clientele.
